text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ââHAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead, it's number 1, Yaeno Muteki! 
It is Yaeno Muteki!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She did it! Yaeno Muteki has won her 4th 
race!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Mejiro Ramonu's younger sister... 
Guess things don't go as smoothly as with 
her sister, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty harsh to compare them after 
all, huh~. I wonder how the Derby's gonna 
go...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I won...! I have conquered the Satsuki 
Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeah!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The Nippon Derby will be mine too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ngh……——

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I fell short of victory... How 
pathetic――)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No good... At this rate, it's completely 
hopeless!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to become like her... I want to 
catch up to her...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to win the race that person yearned 
for...—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—I was supposed to win...! That's what I 
decided... what I swore to do!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"—If I stay like this, I won't be able to 
win the 'Nippon Derby'...! I'll lose... to 
Yaeno-san...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I have to train... more, more, more, 
more...!!

When I went to greet Mejiro Ardan after 
she finished the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry. ...It was a pathetic 
showing on my part.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Far from casting a shadow over the 
jewel's brilliance, I ended up exposing 
the shortcomings of my own shine..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly say I gave it my "all" just 
now...

"She seemed too frustrated to notice, but 
Mejiro Ardan had just run the Satsuki Sho, 
and yet she walked right back to me with 
her head held high."

Right after crossing the finish line in 
her debut race, she had collapsed from 
sheer exhaustion, but now she stood firmly 
on her feet even after a GⅠ.

It spoke volumes of how much she had 
grown, now capable of contending in a GⅠ 
race...!
choice_data_list:
Let's use today's experience and keep 
striving to improve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because Trainer is looking 
steadily ahead... that I am able to move 
forward as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to apply today's lessons in 
the Aoba Sho, so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to your continued guidance 
and support.

The Aoba Sho is just around the corner. We 
reaffirmed our vow to achieve a result 
that will lead into the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby)!
